mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_agent_delegations (agent_id, grantor_user_id, tenant_id, resource, actions, resource_scope, expires_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{grantorUserId}, #{tenantId}, #{resource}, #{actions}, #{resourceScope}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_agent_delegations WHERE grantor_user_id = #{grantorUserId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_agent_delegations SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND grantor_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE t_agent_delegations SET status = 'ACTIVE', revoked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND grantor_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'REVOKED' AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_agent_delegations WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource = #{resource} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > NOW() AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{action}, actions) > 0) AND (resource_scope = '*' OR resource_scope = #{resourceId}) ORDER BY expires_at ASC
